meta.title: Full-Stack & AI Engineer
meta.summary: Smart India Hackathon 2025 National Finalist and Full-Stack & AI Engineer with production experience at Sendlume. Open-source contributor across organizations including sktime. Specializing in backend engineering, distributed systems, and AI/ML pipelines.

bullets: Led architecture of Sendlume’s AI workflow generation system, reducing LLM token costs from 3M to 20K (99% reduction) by redesigning prompt pipelines.
Designed and deployed a pixel-level email tracking microservice processing 10,000+ events/day with high reliability using invisible beacon technology and an async event queue.
Engineered an AI workflow canvas with a node-based visual interface backed by a stateless REST API, enabling non-technical users to design and deploy automation pipelines.
Built a real-time analytics dashboard using WebSocket streams and Redis-cached PostgreSQL aggregations, delivering live campaign KPIs with sub-100ms latency.
Maintained scalable DevOps infrastructure using Neon, Redis, Docker, improving system uptime and deployment efficiency.
Modeled natural gas prices using time-series techniques – seasonality decomposition and multi-horizon forecasting – achieving reliable short- and long-term price projections.
Built a P&L estimation engine for commodity storage contracts, factoring in injection, withdrawal, and holding costs to support trading decisions.
Developed an ML-based Probability of Default (PD) model using logistic regression, improving loan default prediction accuracy by ~15% over baseline heuristics.
Segmented credit scores into dynamic risk tiers using statistical bucketing, directly informing credit approval decision thresholds.
